title: TokenWright access projection
description: How this box is reached and who holds a key to it. Admin-gated: a list of key names and where the box answers is reconnaissance. Secret-free with exactly one deliberate exception, `reveal`, described on that field.

desired.description: The keys this box should hold, by name. The box mints what is missing and revokes what is dropped. Names, never values.

keys.description: One name per client that uses this box. Per-client so that revoking an editor's key does not also cut off the paired Home.

pairing.description: The Home this box serves. There is no state field here and no `unpaired` value: an unpaired box does not answer the management surface at all, so a document that could be read is by construction a document from a paired box.

home.description: The Home that claimed this box. One at a time — a second Home does not pair alongside the first, it claims a box that has been unpaired.

fingerprint.description: The box's own certificate fingerprint, pinned by the Home when it claimed the box. Not a secret: it is what the Home compares against, and a change is an alarm rather than an update. Projected for comparison by eye only — the Home pins what the transport presented, never a field the box authors about itself.

relay.description: The path GaugeDesk uses. The box dials out; nothing here is an address anyone can connect to.

direct.description: The WireGuard path, for the operator's own OpenAI-compatible tools. GaugeDesk never uses it.

base_url.description: What to paste into a tool. Null when direct access is off.

prefix.description: First few characters, enough to match a key against a client's configuration and not enough to use.

last_used_at.description: Null means never used, which for an old key is worth noticing.

reveal.description: The one place a secret appears, and it is deliberate. A key is useless if its value is never shown, so a freshly minted key is carried here until the operator acknowledges it, after which it is null forever. It is held rather than cleared on read, so reading a document has no side effect and the value cannot be missed. This crosses the management surface, which is end-to-end encrypted to a principal already holding administrative capability over the box.
